seo.title: Best Fine Dining in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Casablanca's top fine dining restaurants for 2026. From iconic Rick's Cafe to oceanfront elegance and authentic Moroccan flavors, explore the city's culinary gems.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's fine dining scene offers a vibrant mix of traditional Moroccan hospitality, sophisticated French cuisine, fresh seafood, and international flavors, often with stunning ocean views or historical backdrops.

picks.name: Le Cabestan Ocean View
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched dramatically on the Casablanca Corniche, Le Cabestan offers an unparalleled dining experience with panoramic ocean views. Renowned for its refined French and Mediterranean cuisine, especially fresh seafood, the elegant interior and exceptional service create a truly luxurious atmosphere. It's perfect for a special occasion or a romantic evening.
picks.whatToOrder: The Pan-Seared Scallops with Truffle Risotto or any of their daily fresh fish preparations.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table by the window well in advance, especially for sunset, to secure the best ocean views.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Cabestan is pricey but absolutely worth it for the view alone, the food is just a bonus! Had the best lobster there."

picks.name: Iloli
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Iloli brings a sophisticated taste of Japan to Casablanca with its exquisite contemporary Japanese cuisine. The minimalist yet elegant decor provides a serene backdrop for expertly crafted sushi, sashimi, and innovative hot dishes. The focus is on premium ingredients and precise culinary techniques, offering a refined dining journey for enthusiasts of Japanese gastronomy.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Omakase' chef's tasting menu for a full experience, or the Black Cod with Miso.
picks.insiderTip: Consider trying their selection of sake or Japanese whiskies to complement your meal.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're looking for real, high-end Japanese in Casablanca, Iloli is the place. Their sushi is art."

picks.name: Rick's Cafe
picks.whyItMadeTheList: An iconic recreation of the legendary bar from the movie 'Casablanca,' Rick's Cafe offers a unique blend of nostalgia, live jazz, and a refined international menu. While the food is excellent, the true draw is the immersive atmosphere, complete with a piano bar and classic decor. It's a must-visit for its historical ambiance and charming appeal.
picks.whatToOrder: The Filet Mignon with a classic 'As Time Goes By' cocktail.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are essential, especially for dinner. Arrive early to enjoy a drink at the bar before your table is ready.
picks.redditQuote: "Rick's Cafe is touristy, yes, but it's an experience you can't miss in Casablanca. The piano player really sets the mood."

picks.name: Bleu (Four Seasons Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located within the luxurious Four Seasons Hotel, Bleu offers elegant French and Mediterranean cuisine with stunning ocean views from its terrace. The restaurant emphasizes seasonal ingredients and masterful execution, delivering a sophisticated yet approachable menu. The impeccable service and chic setting make it a top choice for a refined dining experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The Seafood Platter or their expertly prepared Steak Frites, paired with a fine Moroccan wine.
picks.insiderTip: Request a table on the outdoor terrace for breathtaking sunset views over the Atlantic.
picks.redditQuote: "Bleu at the Four Seasons is consistently excellent. Always great service and the food is just divine, especially their seafood."

picks.name: Maison B
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Maison B is a trendy and stylish venue known for its innovative fusion cuisine that creatively blends Moroccan flavors with international techniques. The chic, contemporary decor and lively ambiance attract a fashionable crowd. It's a great spot for those seeking a modern fine dining experience with a vibrant social scene and creative dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: The Duck Pastilla or the signature 'Maison B' Burger for a gourmet twist.
picks.insiderTip: This spot often transforms into a lounge with a DJ later in the evening, making it a great place to stay for post-dinner drinks.
picks.redditQuote: "Maison B is super chic, definitely the place to see and be seen. Their fusion dishes are surprisingly good."

picks.name: La Sqala
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Set within an 18th-century fortress bastion, La Sqala offers an authentic and enchanting Moroccan dining experience. Surrounded by lush gardens and historic architecture, guests can enjoy traditional Moroccan tagines, pastillas, and grilled meats in a truly unique setting. It's a journey back in time, celebrating rich culinary heritage.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their Slow-Cooked Tagines (Lamb with Prunes is a classic) or the Assortment of Moroccan Salads.
picks.insiderTip: Visit for breakfast or lunch to enjoy the beautiful garden courtyard in daylight, which offers a more relaxed, but still refined, experience.
picks.redditQuote: "La Sqala is touristy, but for good reason. The setting is absolutely stunning and the Moroccan food is genuinely delicious."

picks.name: Ostréa
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For seafood aficionados, Ostréa is a must-visit, offering an elegant dining experience focused entirely on the freshest catches. Located near the fishing port, the restaurant prides itself on its raw bar, featuring an impressive selection of oysters and shellfish, alongside beautifully prepared fish dishes. The atmosphere is sophisticated and subtly nautical.
picks.whatToOrder: A grand plateau de fruits de mer (seafood platter) or the Grilled Sole Meunière.
picks.insiderTip: Ask the staff for recommendations on the freshest daily specials, which often include unique local catches.
picks.redditQuote: "Ostréa's seafood platter is a dream. Seriously, the freshest oysters I've had outside of France, right here in Casablanca."

picks.name: Basmane (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Basmane, located in the Kenzi Tower Hotel, offers a luxurious immersion into Moroccan culinary traditions. The lavish decor, featuring intricate mosaics and rich textiles, creates an opulent setting for enjoying classic Moroccan dishes with a refined touch. Live traditional music often accompanies dinner, enhancing the authentic cultural experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The Royal Couscous or the Mechoui (slow-roasted lamb), often served in a grand ceremony.
picks.insiderTip: They often have live entertainment with traditional Moroccan music and belly dancing, check their schedule when booking for a full experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Basmane is super fancy Moroccan food. It's a bit of a splurge but the ambiance and the quality of the tagines are incredible."

picks.name: Bistrot Chic
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bistrot Chic offers a contemporary take on classic French bistro fare in a stylish and intimate setting. The menu features expertly prepared dishes using fresh, high-quality ingredients, served with a modern flair. It's a favorite among locals for its consistent quality, sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere, and excellent wine list.
picks.whatToOrder: The Duck Confit or the Beef Tartare, prepared tableside.
picks.insiderTip: The outdoor terrace is charming in good weather and perfect for a more casual, yet still elegant, dining experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Bistrot Chic never disappoints. Their steak frites are perfect every time and the service is always spot on."

picks.name: Restaurant du Port de Pêche
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A long-standing institution right at the fishing port, this restaurant delivers incredibly fresh seafood in a bustling, authentic atmosphere. While less formal than some other fine dining options, its commitment to quality ingredients and simple, delicious preparation elevates it. It's where locals go for the real taste of Casablanca's ocean bounty.
picks.whatToOrder: The Grilled Fish of the Day (ask what just came in) or the Calamari Fritti.
picks.insiderTip: Go for lunch when the port is most active and the fish is arguably at its absolute freshest. Expect a lively, slightly noisy atmosphere.
picks.redditQuote: "Forget fancy, if you want fresh, perfectly cooked fish, Restaurant du Port de Pêche is the spot. So good and not nearly as expensive as the others."

picks.name: White Elephant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: White Elephant brings the vibrant and aromatic flavors of authentic Thai cuisine to Casablanca. The restaurant's elegant decor, featuring Thai artifacts and a serene ambiance, transports diners to Southeast Asia. Their menu boasts a wide array of classic Thai dishes, prepared with traditional spices and fresh ingredients, offering a unique fine dining alternative.
picks.whatToOrder: The Green Curry with Prawns or the Pad Thai, both perfectly balanced and flavorful.
picks.insiderTip: If you enjoy spicy food, don't hesitate to ask for extra chili – they can adjust the heat level to your preference.
picks.redditQuote: "Was surprised to find such good Thai food in Casablanca at White Elephant. The decor is beautiful and the curries are spot on."

picks.name: Lily's (Hyatt Regency)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated within the prestigious Hyatt Regency Casablanca, Lily's offers a sophisticated international menu with a strong Mediterranean influence. The bright, contemporary setting and attentive service create an upscale yet inviting atmosphere. It’s known for its diverse menu that caters to various palates, from perfectly grilled meats to fresh pasta dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: Their daily special from the grill or the Seabass en Papillote.
picks.insiderTip: Lily's often hosts special culinary events and themed buffets, so check their schedule for unique dining experiences.
picks.redditQuote: "Lily's at the Hyatt is a solid choice for a business dinner or if you just want consistently good international food in a nice setting."

faq.question: What is the typical price range for fine dining in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Fine dining in Casablanca generally ranges from 300 MAD to over 1000 MAD ($30 to $100+) per person for a main course, appetizer, and dessert, excluding drinks. Mid-range fine dining experiences average around 400-700 MAD ($40-70), while top-tier establishments can easily exceed 800-1000 MAD ($80-100) per person, especially with wine.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for fine dining restaurants in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Yes, it is highly recommended to make reservations, especially for popular fine dining spots like Le Cabestan Ocean View or Rick's Cafe, and particularly on weekends or for special occasions. Booking a few days to a week in advance is advisable to secure your preferred time and table, especially if you desire a specific view or ambiance.

faq.question: What kind of cuisine can I expect from fine dining in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Casablanca's fine dining scene is wonderfully diverse. You can find exquisite traditional Moroccan cuisine in lavish settings, sophisticated French and Mediterranean dishes, fresh seafood restaurants capitalizing on the city's coastal location, and even high-end Japanese, Thai, and international fusion options. There's truly something for every discerning palate.

faq.question: Are there dress code requirements for fine dining establishments?
faq.answer: Most fine dining restaurants in Casablanca maintain an elegant or smart casual dress code. For men, this typically means collared shirts and trousers (no shorts or sandals). For women, elegant dresses, skirts, or smart trousers are appropriate. While not always strictly enforced, dressing up enhances the experience and is respectful of the establishment's ambiance.

faq.question: Can I find vegetarian or vegan options at Casablanca's fine dining restaurants?
faq.answer: While traditional Moroccan cuisine often features many vegetarian dishes (like vegetable tagines and salads), it's best to check with individual restaurants in advance regarding vegan options. Many fine dining establishments, especially those with international menus, are accustomed to accommodating dietary restrictions and can often prepare suitable plant-based dishes upon request.

faq.question: What are the best areas in Casablanca for fine dining?
faq.answer: The Corniche Ain Diab area is renowned for its stunning oceanfront fine dining, offering breathtaking views. The upscale neighborhoods of Anfa and Gauthier also host several modern and sophisticated establishments. For traditional Moroccan fine dining and iconic venues, the areas around the Ancienne Medina and Centre Ville provide excellent choices, often within luxury hotels.

methodology: Our selection of Casablanca's best fine dining establishments is based on extensive research, including expert culinary reviews, local recommendations, and consistent diner feedback. We prioritize venues that offer exceptional food quality, impeccable service, unique ambiance, and a memorable overall experience, ensuring a diverse range of cuisines and styles.
